limitations.note: The patch fixed the combinational feedback in `q` but exposed the post-rotation bit instead of registering the pre-rotation bit, advancing the output by one cycle and delaying reset until a rising clock edge.

The test started at the second pattern bit after reset release and expected the old output to hold after reset assertion, so it validated the patch’s assumptions rather than checking the required output phase and immediate reset.
